claim: In fiscal 2023, AMD's revenue came in at $25.6B.
summary: AMD's reported fiscal 2023 (calendar year ended Dec 31, 2023) revenue was approximately $22.68B (~$22.7B), not $25.6B. The $25.6B figure is materially higher (~13% overstatement) and is close to AMD's FY2024 revenue (~$25.8B), so the claim is contradicted by model parametric knowledge.

sub_claims.text: AMD's revenue in fiscal 2023 was $25.6 billion
sub_claims.stated_text: In fiscal 2023, AMD's revenue came in at $25.6B.
